SMTO-WEB-0039 — SMTO looked up a research note that doesn't exist

GUID: e28a0e7a-369c-5b1a-952e-30210bef88d3
Slug: research-reference-not-found
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web_research

What happened

  • While researching, SMTO tried to open one of its own notes with a label that doesn't match anything, or to ask you about something already settled. Nothing new was fetched and nothing was lost.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Let SMTO continue for a moment; it usually picks a valid note on its next step. This is a mix-up in SMTO's own notes, and it can find the right label among the results it has already gathered.
  2. If SMTO stops or keeps repeating this, send a short message restating your question and the item you care about. Restating gives SMTO a clear starting point instead of the outdated label.
  3. Check that the final answer names a real source for each point. SMTO must not fill the gap with a result it couldn't find.

What success looks like

  • SMTO's activity moves on to reading or answering, and this message doesn't come back.

If it still fails

  • If it repeats several times in a row, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • read_research_evidence could not resolve the given result_id/subject_id (or there is no research state), or ask_user targeted a research_entity_id that is missing or no longer unresolved.

What this means

  • Evidence expansion cannot resolve the reference or research state, or entity clarification targets a missing or already resolved entity. The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.

Why this can happen

  • Evidence expansion cannot resolve the reference or research state, or entity clarification targets a missing or already resolved entity.

How to diagnose it

  • Identify whether the rejected reference came from result expansion or entity clarification and inspect its current state.

How to fix it

  • Use a result_id from the current research packet or an entity_id that is still UNRESOLVED/ALTERNATIVES_ONLY in entity_resolutions; candidate_result_ids in the failure lists only results containing the given reference, so it is usually empty here. Do not invent the missing result or swap in a different reference without checking its identity.
  • Use the current packet's result references or unresolved entity IDs for the corresponding control.

Retry and execution caution

  • Use an existing result reference or an eligible unresolved entity for the corresponding control.

How to verify the fix

  • The request uses an existing expandable result or an eligible unresolved entity.

What not to do

  • Do not invent the missing result or entity, or substitute a different reference without checking its identity.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
